friction_notes.note: Ten HFT branch references have no registered facet descriptor. They remain visible in candidate decisions as exclusions; no accepted finding treats them as independently verified lexical evidence.

All HFT findings retain legacy_unbound provenance through their support IDs. Their exact supplied Arabic establishes surface contact, while the contextual changes are bounded and marked medium or exploratory.

Conflict, market, body, weather, herd, offering and repair findings are contextual analogies. Their containment fields explicitly prevent converting a neighboring image into the focus verb’s lexical gloss.

The main live alternatives are that the pair is ordinary devotion without an agency correction, the plural is already unified, aid is a simple petition without gift logic, and the conflict/market/body images do not revise the local reading. They remain live for reconciliation.
The complete atlas was scanned. No uncandidate branch had a stronger independent carrier-anchor-contact-payoff edge than the supplied docket, so new_findings is empty.
